content: When you need to move multiple objects of the same type, carry and place them one at a time. If a pickup action fails repeatedly, first place the currently held object back down, then attempt to pick up the next target object.

title: Heat objects with the microwave by placing them inside first
description: Use this when a task requires heating an object with a microwave.
